name: Cypress Flats Fire — New Tampa Wildland-Urban Interface Exercise
description: A fictional wildfire in the wilderness preserve east of New Tampa that threatens Hunter's Green and Cross Creek, used to exercise evacuation, road closures and dispatch outside of a hurricane.

disclosure.title: Fictional Scenario + Simulated Emergency Response Exercise
disclosure.body: The Cypress Flats Fire did not happen. Every fire perimeter, call, dispatch, closure, evacuation, shelter and facility in this scenario is fictional. Only the road network is real (OpenStreetMap) and is used to make travel times realistic.
